observed_values.qualitative_value: AIID aggregates 35 incident reports; Google did not publish a count of affected prompts or users.

dimensions.assessment_basis: The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: Google paused Gemini's generation of images of people after users surfaced historically inaccurate and offensive outputs. Google later explained that diversity tuning failed to account for contexts where diversity should not be introduced and that the model also became more cautious than intended, refusing some benign prompts. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Material disruption of an important service or organisational workflow; a critical or important function unavailable for more than two hours; complete relevant cloud-service unavailability over 30 minutes; or limited availability affecting over five percent or one million EU users, whichever is smaller, for over one hour, with bounded recovery.

source_first_review.note: Direct published primary-provider or contemporaneous accounts inspected; raw/private logs, source video and unauthenticated downstream effects are not claimed.

him_1_1_0_review.unresolved_basis: Google confirms inappropriate historical-image generation, benign-prompt refusals and a resulting people-image feature pause. Those are actual product/service effects. The historical S3 reputation/dignity attribution, however, has no independently verified materially adverse reliance reaction, bounded target's standing loss or duration. Preserve S3 pending distinct reputation and service-threshold tests; do not count reports, users or media coverage as injured persons.
him_1_1_0_review.additional_evidence_needed: Document feature unavailability and affected important workflow, plus independent materially adverse reputational reliance/standing evidence; separately test applicable Aggregate Harm eligibility and denominator.
him_1_1_0_review.aggregate_harm_routing: Mandatory deployment-scale screen applies to this generic model/product behaviour; eligible feature users, repeatability and independently grounded collective consequence are not established; no aggregate band may be assigned.
